step1_analysis.description: A basic NMOS current mirror extracted from a sense amplifier circuit. It mirrors the input current at the bitline (BL) to the output node (OUT1).

paper_reference.title: A High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier for Nonvolatile Memories

current_mirror_ratio.description: Ratio of output current to input current

sky130_expected.calculation: W1=W2 and L1=L2, so ratio is ideally 1.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matched transistors yield a 1:1 current ratio, with slight deviations due to channel length modulation if Vds1 != Vds2.
Depends on the channel length modulation parameter (lambda) of the SKY130 NMOS at L=0.5um.

minimum_output_voltage.description: Minimum output voltage to keep the output transistor in saturation (Vdsat)

sky130_expected.calculation: Vdsat = sqrt(2 * Iout / (un*Cox * W/L)) = sqrt(2 * 10uA / (270uA/V^2 * 10)) = 86 mV
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law model for SKY130 NMOS parameters.

bandwidth.description: -3dB bandwidth of the current transfer function

sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is determined by the pole at the diode-connected node, which depends on gm and parasitic capacitances.

delay.description: Transient delay from input current step to output current step

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ~ 1 / (2*pi*fT) ~ 30 ps for the mirror alone.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 30ns for the entire sense amplifier. The isolated current mirror is much faster.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure current mirror ratio, output resistance, minimum output voltage, bandwidth, and delay.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Current Mirror Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM2 OUT1 BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 BL BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Power supply (used as reference)
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Output voltage source (holds OUT1 at 0.9V for nominal operation)
Vout OUT1 0 0.9

* Input current source (DC 10uA, AC 1A, Pulse 0 to 10uA)
Iin VDD BL_in DC 10u AC 1 PULSE(0 10u 1n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
Vmeas_in BL_in BL 0

* CCVS to convert currents to voltages for AC measurement
H1 out_meas 0 Vout -1
H2 in_meas 0 Vmeas_in 1

.control
* 1. DC Sweep for Output Resistance and Vmin
dc Vout 0 1.8 0.01
let i_out = -i(Vout)
meas dc iout_09 find i_out at=0.9
meas dc iout_10 find i_out at=1.0
let rout_approx = 0.1 / (iout_10 - iout_09)
print rout_approx

let iout_target = 0.9 * iout_09
meas dc vmin find v(OUT1) when i_out=iout_target

* 2. AC Analysis for Bandwidth
ac dec 20 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(out_meas) - vdb(in_meas)
meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=1k
let gain_db_3db = dc_gain_db - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis for Delay
tran 0.1n 20n
let i_out_tran = -i(Vout)
let i_in_tran = i(Vmeas_in)
meas tran t_delay trig i_in_tran val=5u rise=1 targ i_out_tran val=5u rise=1

* 4. DC Operating Point for Current Ratio
op
let i_out_op = -i(Vout)
let i_in_op = i(Vmeas_in)
let current_ratio = i_out_op / i_in_op
print current_ratio

quit
.endc
.end
